signInSubtitle: Sign in to see your family.
signUpSubtitle: We only ask for what's needed.
signUpAdult: I confirm I am 18 or older
signUpAdultNote: For now Nexo Familia is for adults only.
privacySummaryBody:
• Your location is only shared if you turn it on, with the families you choose, and you can pause it at any time.
• We don't keep a location history: only the latest one, deleted when you pause or leave a group.
• Events are kept for 30 days and SOS alerts for 90 days.
• We don't sell your data or use it for advertising.
• You can delete your account and data from Settings.
resetBody: Enter your email and we'll send you instructions.
resetSent: If an account exists for that email, you'll receive instructions in a few minutes.
authErrorEmailInUse: An account with that email already exists. Sign in or reset your password.
authErrorSignupIncomplete: Your sign-up didn't finish. Go to "Create account" again with the same email and password to complete it.
